interpretation: No source outage/mapping/HTTP denial reproduced in four availability controls
Beta is slower than Standard in these matched-episode headless controls, with 11 Apothecary audio renditions
Beta observed60 child-resource opening events before FILE_LOADED versus9 for Standard; log events are not a wire-level unique HTTP-request count
Sampled playlists and first128KiB video/preferred-audio payloads are fast; partial samples cannot prove whole-segment throughput or all CDN locations
Most Beta delay precedes FILE_LOADED; external subtitle commands add a smaller observed delay
Disabling stream-info probing or shortening analysis shows no reliable gain after cold/warm effects; no player tuning recommended
User same-device Exo comparison supports player-specific initialization overhead; it does not establish every cause or a dated regression
No previous comparable wrapped-stream startup baseline establishes that the service worsened since24 November
Keep unmodified multi-audio master; no plugin release/track stripping/URL substitution/cache change justified
limits: Small sample, shared upstream cache effects, fresh-grant requests do not guarantee cold CDN resources
Desktop library/network differs from Android device/build/network
No full episode/seek or all audio-language switching tested
No ExoPlayer cloud benchmark; faster Exo is user-reported
No raw grants, signed URLs, headers, HLS bodies or caption dialogue persisted
